provenance.paper_title: StoryMem: Multi-shot Long Video Storytelling with Memory

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: A compact bank stores selected keyframes from previously generated shots and injects them into later generation.
During operation, StoryMem applies fixed-rule insertion or replacement to historical keyframe memory bank; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

Only informative and aesthetically stable keyframes survive the compact-memory selection process. For StoryMem, this specifically supports explicit deletion or eviction of stored items of historical keyframe memory bank.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 3): During inference, the operative memory component (historical keyframe memory bank) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement, explicit deletion or eviction of stored items; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
